explanation.body: Its forecast takes this form: probability, over 1, 5 and 21 sessions. It is graded on a score that rewards probabilities that land close to what actually happens. It would be ended if after 100 sessions per index cell, it does not beat the dead model's Brier score, or its reliability error exceeds 10 points. It counts as proven at 100 sessions per index cell.
explanation.summary: State the chance that SPY and QQQ actually reach a price level, as a number this page is graded against.

history.label: History, not live forecasts
history.note: Worked out day by day over the price history on record: each day's chances were built only from earlier days whose touch results were already known by that day, then checked against what the highs and lows actually did. These are study figures from the past, not the live record above. The old model's score is worked out on exactly the same days.

kill_criterion: This tool is retired if, after 100 trading days of live forecasts for each index and each cell, its score is not better than the old model's score on the same days, or its stated chances are more than 10 points away from how often touches actually happened.

engine1_band_check.basis: Engine 1's published 68 percent band edges matched to the cent after applying the FE12 session quality guard widen factor Engine 1 publishes on its own page to the recomputed unwidened half-width (factor 1.0 when no guard widening is recorded). This engine's own barriers stay on the unwidened recipe.

positioning_split.note: No split by dealer positioning is shown. There is no daily record of whether options dealers would speed up or slow down a move covering these trading days, so the chances above are not split that way, here or in the history below.
